Initialize a new drt project in the current directory.

## Usage

```bash
drt init [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--from-dbt` | `TEXT` |  | Path to dbt manifest.json — generate sync YAMLs from dbt models. |
| `--from-ossie` | `TEXT` |  | Path to an Apache Ossie YAML/JSON model — generate sync YAMLs from datasets. |
| `--dataset` | `TEXT` |  | Ossie dataset name to scaffold. Repeat to select multiple; default: all with keys. |
| `--destination` | `TEXT` | `postgres` | Destination scaffold for --from-ossie: postgres \| hubspot. |
| `--dialect` | `TEXT` | `ANSI_SQL` | Preferred Ossie field-expression dialect; falls back to ANSI_SQL. |
| `--output-dir` | `PATH` | `syncs` | Directory for --from-ossie generated sync YAMLs. |
| `--template` | `TEXT` |  | Scaffold from a curated template. Use 'list' to see available templates. |
